attr.title: PaperBoat
attr.desc: PaperBoat is the HarbourMasters PC port of Paper Mario, built from the decompilation, with enhancements such as higher frame rates, widescreen support and mod support.
attr.inst: Copy your Paper Mario US .z64 rom to ports/paperboat. On first launch answer Yes to the prompts to convert it to pm64.o2r, which can take a few minutes.
